The Hollins Public Library is hiring a part-time Library Assistant to join our circulation team. You will check materials in and out, help patrons find books and use the public computers, shelve returned items, and process holds and interlibrary loans. The ideal candidate enjoys working with the public and is comfortable with basic computer tasks. Must be at least 18 years old and have a high school diploma or GED. Previous customer service experience is required. Experience with an integrated library system such as Koha is a plus, and Spanish language skills are preferred. This position works 20 hours per week, including some evenings and Saturdays. Pay starts at $16 per hour. The Hollins Public Library is an equal opportunity employer.
